name: standard-v2
note: THE CALIBRATION TABLE, REBUILT — and NOT YET CALIBRATED. `standard` paired the strongest deck we have measured with the weakest: giada-angels 0.572 [0.515, 0.628] against baylen-tokens 0.052 [0.032, 0.084] over 290 decided games, an eleven-fold spread that made the subject seat's null 0.159 rather than 0.250. Both are consistent ACROSS tables and not artifacts of one: giada also took 0.401 of vito-era (1.6x fair) and baylen also floored there at 0.016, and a seat-order check on the 2026-09-04 run showed giada winning from all four positions (0.867 / 0.733 / 0.533 / 0.533), so it is the deck and not the chair. This table drops both and keeps abaddon, the closest to even anything has measured at 0.87x fair. It has NEVER BEEN RUN, so it has no null of its own and no claim is made that it is level — `pods standard-v2 --calibration` after some games is what would earn that. A cross-table win rate is not a power ranking: nekusar's 0.273 was measured in a FIVE-player pod and does not transfer.

seats.note: Kept. 0.217 [0.174, 0.268] over 290 decided games in `standard`, 0.87x fair — the only seat any table has produced that sits near even.
1.36x fair in the FIVE-player playgroup pod, the middle band there. Non-combat damage is the axis PRD-v1 s14 says actually wins, and the old standard table had none of it.
UNMEASURED anywhere. Here for the axis rather than for a number: a value chain that survives wipes, which is the other half of the s14 note.
